title: Infinitive complements
subtitle: Identify the verb that makes “to …” necessary.
overview: An infinitive can complete a verb of ability, desire, command, beginning, or saying. Find its governing verb before translating it as a free English phrase.
The understood subject may be shared with the governing verb or expressed separately; do not supply one without evidence.

items.en: God is able to do all things.

items.grc: εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἀκολουθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτόν.
items.en: If anyone wishes to follow after me, let him deny himself.
